title: The Hole in the Penrose
hook: Tear a hole in a pattern that never repeats.
sub: A 20-qubit quantum blur scrambles a hole in a Penrose tiling. You put the pattern back, tile by tile.
you_control: Fly the mender moth over the hole to paint tiles back
Move the hole to any of nine computed positions
Wipe to compare with the original
Flip through the 12-job parameter sweep and share your view
qubits_note: 541 px hole bounding box -> ceil(log2 541) x 2 = 20 qubits, blur-v1's maximum (documented rule)
honesty: blur-v1 runs on Atlas's classical statevector simulator; the repair is classical geometry; Atlas did not run an error-correcting code.
